tree.heading: Federal Charter.—
tree.text: Jewish War Veterans, U.S.A., National Memorial, Incorporated (in this chapter, the “corporation”), is a federally chartered corporation.

tree.heading: Place of Incorporation and Domicile.—
tree.text: The corporation is declared to be a nonprofit corporation incorporated and domiciled in the District of Columbia.

tree.heading: Perpetual Existence.—
tree.text: Except as otherwise provided, the corporation has perpetual existence.
